detected_by: team-lead reading launch3.log/launch4.log tails instead of trusting driver.sh's own exit code
impact: Desktop app on-screen verification (driver.sh launch) failed 4 times before success: wrapper-obscures-real-process pattern repeated 3x in one cycle -- GTK-init misdiagnosis, vite-server misdiagnosis, then the real cause (cold 496-crate rust build racing epic-16-backfill's concurrent source edits, which invalidate the shared cargo build cache and reset tauri's file-watcher mid-compile). Fixed by pre-building with a plain 'cargo build' (no watcher) to warm the shared target dir, then launching immediately.
resolution: cargo build (warm the target dir, no watcher) then driver.sh launch immediately while cache is hot; succeeded on the next attempt
